nodes.title: Short explainer pages ("About ...")
nodes.job: The short "About" pages stay as they are and link to their treatment page. No new work. Two of them are redirect proposals (see below).

reasons: The homepage is thin. It has {home_words} words. The floor is {floor} words (median {median} words of the clinic homepages). The service pages have {svc_min} to {svc_max} words. Most pages exist. The work is prices, proof, the doctors and a clear order.

Two money topics are hidden from Google. The IV drip page (2,578 words) and the acupuncture page (1,222 words) carry noindex and are not in the sitemap (live check 13.10.2026). "iv drip bali" has 1,300 searches a month.
Brand search carries the site. The homepage has 1,289 clicks in 3 months. The strongest service page is skin tag removal with 175 clicks.
Short copies split the signal. Some treatments have a short "About" page next to the full page, for example /gynecoaesthetic (80 words) next to /gyneco-aesthetic (674 words).
Links are not the first gap. The domain shows 1,001 referring domains, but most came in one spam wave (pool item CP-AUT-006). The profile name, prices and the doctors come first.
not_built: Area pages for Ubud, Seminyak and Uluwatu: one address only, no local proof (CP-LOC-004, cut).
Naturopathy and live blood analysis: the client gave them up on 30.07. Martin 13.10.: remove from site and profile after the client's OK (CP-SVC-026). /about-naturopathy is already noindex.
Detox and colon hydrotherapy: not offered (CP-SVC-027, cut).
Breathwork, sound healing and screaming therapy, IV drip at home and Bali belly, general doctor: only after the client says yes (CP-SVC-023, 024, 025, Martin 13.10.).

redirect_proposals.reason: Short "About" page (80 words). 66 percent of its five-word sequences are on the full page (674 words). Both pages read 13.10. Only with Martin's go.
Short "About Infusions" page (104 words), 59 percent of its text is on /infusionstreatment. Only after noindex is lifted on the IV page and with Martin's go.

Older infusion page (995 words, 13 impressions) with the same job as the IV page (2,578 words, "IV Drip Therapy & Infusions in Canggu"). Both pages read 13.10., 27 percent overlap, the IV page covers more. Only after noindex is lifted and with Martin's go.
Service given up by the client on 30.07. Martin 13.10.: remove after the client's OK. Only with the client's OK and Martin's go.
